title: Extremal Marginal States of Maximal Rank in $(d, d+m)$
summary: We study the extreme points of the convex set $\mathcal{C}(ρ_1,ρ_2)$ of bipartite quantum states with fixed marginals $ρ_1$ and $ρ_2$. We construct extreme points in $(d,\,d+m)$ dimension, of rank $d+m$, matching the highest possible value, for all $d\geq 3$, $m > \frac{d^2-2d-2}{2}$ (when $d=2$, $m\geq 1$). This proves the existence of extremal states with relatively large rank and also covers all the known examples.
